title: The Stacking Cups Lesson
can_do: 教别人一样新本领时，边讲边确认“你听懂了吗”，并回答问题。

conversation_move.label: teach a skill and check understanding

trigger: Teacher has not seen the new stacking game, so Child teaches her and checks her steps.
setting: Show-and-tell time at the school table.
essential_props: one set of three stacking cups

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Show me your new stacking game!

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: First, the big cup goes down, like this.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Big cup down, got it. Then what?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Then the middle cup, small end up.

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Almost! Turn it, so the stripes match.

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: The stripes match. Then the last one?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Tiny cup on top. Your turn to try!

turns.speaker: teacher
turns.line: Look, I did it! Good teaching?

turns.speaker: child
turns.line: Star student! You get a gold sticker.

replay_cards.title: Show and tell
replay_cards.setting: Child brings the stacking cups to school.
replay_cards.change: His classmates have not seen the game.
replay_cards.challenge: Child teaches the steps to a small group, checks understanding, and praises a classmate's first try.

replay_cards.title: The paper plane
replay_cards.challenge: Child teaches the fold steps, checks that the wings are even, and Max's plane finally glides.

parent_support: 鼓励孩子教伙伴或长辈一样小本领，教比学更巩固。
教的过程中提醒他确认“你听懂了吗”，别一口气讲完。
被教的人要给真实反馈：“这步我没看明白。”让孩子补充解释。
